svg.title: Map of US counties with no locally based news source, with the outlets and creators in this essay marked
svg.desc: Counties Medill counts as having no locally based source of news are shaded gray. Six dots mark the places in the essay: Anaconda MT, Brandon VT, Owen County IN, Estherville IA, Brunswick GA and southern Illinois.

g.text: County with no locally based news source (238)
Base map: Medill Local News Initiative, State of Local News 2026
